title: A price above the reference
hook: Two stated cases: explore the sign of a price difference under a stated value rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the sign of a price difference under a stated value rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the sign of a price difference under a stated value rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: An outcome is 12, its reference is 10, and negative differences count 2 times positive ones. What is its signed model value?
